import pandas as pd

def load_and_prepare_source(filepath):
    """
    Load a source CSV file and ensure the schema and dtypes match the target schema.
    """
    # Define the target schema dtypes
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'Int64',  # Use pandas nullable integer dtype
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # Read CSV with no dtype enforcement first (to avoid errors on missing values)
    df = pd.read_csv(filepath, dtype=str)

    # Strip whitespace from column names (just in case)
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()

    # Convert columns to target dtypes carefully
    for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
        if col not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected column '{col}' not found in source file {filepath}")
        if dtype == 'Int64':
            # Convert to pandas nullable integer dtype
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        elif dtype == 'float64':
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
        elif dtype == 'string':
            df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
        else:
            # fallback, just convert
            df[col] = df[col].astype(dtype)

    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    df = df[list(dtype_map.keys())]

    return df

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Load and prepare each source file, then concatenate
    dfs = []
    for filepath in source_files:
        df = load_and_prepare_source(filepath)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If any further cleaning or transformation is needed, do here
    # For example, ensure no duplicates (not specified, so skipping)
    # Or fill missing values if needed (not specified)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
